purpose: Qualify chemical/fuel control of existing channel and junction availability, explicit owners, and unchanged physical accounting
ownership: Membrane rules require the actual target inside/outside IDs and a fuel pool belonging to that cytosol. GJ rules choose one actual endpoint cytosol and its fuel pool; there is no inferred exterior/edge map. Ephemeral free chemical/fuel samples only.
native_separation: Frozen source NaK/GJ max_effect*alpha and channel alpha are reused with native ordered last-writer replacement per existing named target. Common-stage evaluation and once-only schedule multiplication are new Cells composition. No native SIM lag/order, INIT/profile dispatch, factory channel type selection, core.modulator or outer DChan equivalence is claimed.
domain: All active factors must remain finite in [0,1], including shadowed/blocked rules. Preserve source inhibitor precedence, direct and independent terms; reject escaped factors without clipping. Channel max Dm must be zero; physical permeability already belongs to target. Charged voltage-Hill feedback, GJ env influencers, native capacity/conductance and dedicated calcium-channel consumers are unsupported.
reference: Independent Decimal source factors + independent full 38-field calcium/fuel/Poisson/ledger reference; field/state/control projections reconstructed separately without production imports.
scope_limits: Host NumPy complete-stage/trajectory qualification only; compiled @2/public dispatch remains Chief-owned
Shared channels retain existing law, population and intrinsic gates; native channel labels are factor configuration metadata only
Junction endpoint selection is explicit and multiple rules replace in list order; no hidden endpoint mean/product
No native full solver, SIM timing, INIT/profile dispatch, extra ATP cost, physical inventories, or state dimensions
No polling, changes or reuse claims for active @1 public execution; no automatic follow-up
